title: Gathering place
description: A building people gather in: a community center, senior center, neighborhood house, public rec building or a fire hall that rents a hall (#455). Shared with the groups and third spaces directory (#263). Plain-language guide: content/README.md. Version 1.

other_names.description: Other names sources use. List both when sources disagree.

area.description: Part of the county, for grouping. morgantown means Morgantown and close in.

community.description: The community or town name people would type.

org.description: Slug of a content/orgs entry, if there is one.

text.description: Who runs it, in words, as the source says.

outdoor.description: Pavilion, playground, ballfield and the like, in words.

step_free.description: Only when the source says so.

regular.description: Weekly or monthly happenings in words. Dated events go in content/calendar/ with venue: <slug>.

price.description: As the source gives it, in words. Leave out when not published.

book.description: How to book, in words. Public contact only.

source.description: The page with the price, if not the first source.

place.description: Only an address the place itself (or its owner) publishes. Leave out when sources conflict.

last_activity_seen.description: Date of the newest sign of activity we read. Over 6 months old shows 'No recent activity seen, call first'.

notes.description: Gaps and conflicts residents should know, like 'Sources give two addresses, so call first.'

phone_confirmed.description: When a person confirmed the details by phone (#164).
